verdicts.reason: A: tidy left-aligned stack (brand, wrapped headline, subhead, chips, CTA) on one shared edge, with clear hierarchy and the decorative circles kept in the corners. Its flaws are minor: the right half is fairly empty and the CTA sits a little close to the bottom edge. B: the headline runs almost to the right edge with no margin, and the subhead is indented off the headline's left edge. The CTA floats on the right, cut off from the copy, and the flavour chips have been pushed below it into a detached row, so the reading order is jumbled and there is a large dead gap in the middle.
